FEAT-6-S103.title: Consent Core Logic and Tier Enforcement
FEAT-6-S103.description: Implement core consent evaluation logic within consent_service, including tier classification (Tier 1 vs Tier 2), enforcement of storage rules, and integration with de-identification pipeline per HIPAA Safe Harbor. Ensure all downstream services receive a normalized consent decision object.

FEAT-6-S104.title: Consent Integration with Lead Capture and Unknown Question Flows
FEAT-6-S104.description: Integrate consent workflow with lead_service and unknown_question_service to ensure consent tier is respected before storing user data, capturing leads, or logging unknown questions. Enforce Tier 2 requirement for identifiable storage and fallback to de-identified handling otherwise.

FEAT-6-S105.title: Consent Audit Logging and Persistence
FEAT-6-S105.description: Persist consent decisions, tier transitions, and audit metadata (timestamp, trigger source, data classification) using existing MongoDB logging infrastructure. Ensure traceability for compliance and debugging without storing unauthorized PHI.
